system.production_queue_policy: two queues; shared branch after router at least priority

candidate.geometry: production 128 output columns x 32 routed rows, local128, D8 activation double buffer
candidate.mechanism: prefetch the next K32's eight raw T16 nibble words while current packed dots execute; decode them in place on the following iteration and demand-load d/scale/min metadata
candidate.shape_policy: select P8 only when producer rows >= 512; preserve the previous exact body below 512
invariants: unchanged packed-dot and FP32 K order
candidate.distinction: the rejected prefetch held the complete decoded 40-byte record and raised VGPR 88 to 104; this candidate carries only raw nibble words

correctness.red: The production-shaped P8 parameter initially failed because the wrapper selector did not exist.
correctness.green: The uneven/empty-expert K512/N128 CPU-reference KL and top-1 gate passed.

leaf.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --routing-json /tmp/laguna-lap1-routing-all-shapes.json --rows 256,512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p8 --warmups 5 --samples 41 --burst 7 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-raw-prefetch-p8-confirm.json
leaf.timing: counter-rotated HIP events; both modes include the unchanged D8 activation pack

rocprof.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/laguna-q4-raw-prefetch-p8-trace -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --routing-json /tmp/laguna-lap1-routing-all-shapes.json --rows 512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p8 --warmups 0 --samples 1 --burst 1 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-raw-prefetch-p8-trace-child.json
